<noinclude>{{SbcHeaderLojbanPod|title=Is Anyone in There?|id=A0035}}</noinclude>
{{SbcIntroductionLojbanPod}}
You never know who is in a bathroom! Thus, better check before you enter. JP and Liliana talk about how to do this and all the other things that can happen in Mexican bathrooms ... The key sentence is: '''está ocupado''' – it's busy/someone's in here.
{{SbcSourceLojbanPod|[[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0013|A0013: Doing the laundry]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0062|A0062: At the bank]], [[Lojban by Choice/LojbanPod newbie lesson A0102|A0102: Where is the restroom?]]}}

{{SbcExercisesLojbanPod}}
<noinclude>====Dialogue Translation====
Translate from Lojban to English. Click each bar to check your answer. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| '''Está ocupado.'''
| It's busy.
| '''Ah, disculpe.'''
| Oh, sorry.
| '''No hay problema. Puede pasar.'''
| There's no problem. You can go in.
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Translation====
Cover the right column, translate from Lojban to English and uncover the right column line by line to check your answers. If possible, read the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| '''Está ocupado.'''
| It's busy. 
| '''Ah, disculpe.''' 
| Oh, sorry.
| '''No hay problema. Puede pasar.'''
| There's no problem. You can go in.
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestion
| It's busy.
| '''Está ocupado.'''
| Oh, sorry. (formal)
| '''Ah, disculpe.''' 
| There's no problem. You can go in. (formal)
| '''No hay problema. Puede pasar.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Recall====
Now translate from English to Lojban. Remember to say the Lojban sentences aloud.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| It's busy.
| '''Está ocupado.'''
| Oh, sorry. (formal)
| '''Ah, disculpe.'''
| There's no problem. You can go in. (formal)
| '''No hay problema. Puede pasar.'''
}}</includeonly>
<noinclude>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestion
| Is the bathroom busy?
| '''¿El baño está ocupado?'''
| It's busy! 
| '''¡Está ocupado!'''
| No problem.
| '''No hay problema.'''
| You cannot enter! (formal)
| '''¡No puede pasar!'''
| Oh, sorry! (formal)
| '''Ah, disculpe.'''
}}</noinclude><includeonly>====Dialogue Remix====
Translate this variant of the dialogue from English to Lojban.
{{SbcQuestionPrint
| Is the bathroom busy?
| '''¿El baño está ocupado?'''
| It's busy! 
| '''¡Está ocupado!'''
| No problem.
| '''No hay problema.'''
| You cannot enter! (formal)
| '''¡No puede pasar!'''
| Oh, sorry! (formal)
| '''Ah, disculpe.'''
}}</includeonly>
